summary: You're building a solid foundation across your computing subjects, with everything currently sitting in the developing-to-limited range. The clearest gaps are in your capstone (CSE3CAP), especially project management and industry-standard practice, while your data structures and object-oriented work are steadier. This plan targets the capstone gaps first, then helps you push your CSE1OOF and CSE2ALG results from developing into confident territory. These are formative signals to guide your study, not a judgement on you.

priorities.evidence: This is your lowest attainment at 46.0% in CSE3CAP and is flagged as an isolated gap. Your Sprint Project management reports scored 46.0% (limited), with the marker noting gaps in advanced project management during substantive development implementation.
priorities.actions: Revisit the feedback on CSE3CAP:Assignment: Sprint Project management reports and rebuild one sprint plan from your capstone as a smaller, well-tested example: set clear milestones, track progress, and document decisions as required by CSE3CAP:SILO1. Seek feedback early on a draft before your next submission.
